quests.title: Wangshu Take-Away

dialogue.sit: I've got something else to do.

dialogue.t: Well, have it then. I'll figure something out.
I'm counting on you, then. This Stir-Fried Filet requires careful treatment, so avoid any unnecessary complications.
So, don't touch any weird elements while you're out there, and don't move too fast.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogue.t: Should be here any moment now...

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: Aye, you heard right. Ling'guan ordered some Stir-Fried Filet before heading northwest.
If it isn't too much trouble, deliver it to her while it's hot, will you?
If you meet with an accident along the way, come back here and I'll make you another serving.
Hehe, thanks. I'm surprised that Wangshu Inn delivers this far out...

quests.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...
